cleardata.title: Saved data
cleardata.hint: Atap keeps a copy of what it downloads, so the notch still shows something when you are offline. Clearing it is safe. Atap downloads again when it needs to.
cleardata.someLeft: {size} freed. A few files are in use, so they were left. Try again later.
cleardata.keys: It also removes your Ask AI keys from this PC.
cleardata.keysRemoved: Your Ask AI keys were removed.
